spans.text: [3] AR: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ EN: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

spans.text: [10] AR: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ EN: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

folded.id: and|when|one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the most merciful in comparison
folded.subject: And
folded.object: one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison

spans.text: [17] AR: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ EN: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
[3] AR: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ EN: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

[19] AR: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ EN: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females.

folded.id: but all|that|is not but the enjoyment of worldly life
folded.subject: But all
folded.object: is not but the enjoyment of worldly life

spans.text: But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life.

[30] AR: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ EN: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

[23] AR: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ EN: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

[26] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

folded.id: even|if|i brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?"
folded.subject: Even
folded.object: I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?"

spans.text: [24] AR: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ EN: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?"

folded.id: exalted|is|he who has subjected this to us
folded.subject: Exalted
folded.object: He who has subjected this to us

spans.text: "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

folded.id: for you|of|ships and animals those which you mount
folded.subject: for you
folded.object: ships and animals those which you mount

spans.text: [12] AR: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ EN: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.

folded.id: gave enjoyment|to|these [people of makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear messenger
folded.subject: gave enjoyment
folded.object: these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger

spans.text: [29] AR: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ EN: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

folded.id: have attributed|to|him from his servants a portion
folded.subject: have attributed
folded.object: Him from His servants a portion

spans.text: [15] AR: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ EN: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.
[28] AR: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ EN: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

[10] AR: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ EN: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

folded.id: it|is|we who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service
folded.subject: It
folded.object: We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service

spans.text: It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service.
Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

[20] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ EN: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them."

folded.id: not come|to|them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him
folded.subject: not come
folded.object: them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him

spans.text: [7] AR: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ EN: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
[16] AR: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ EN: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

folded.id: see how|was|the end of the deniers
folded.subject: see how

spans.text: [25] AR: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

folded.id: so|is|one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to allah]?
folded.subject: So
folded.object: one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?

spans.text: [18] AR: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ EN: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
[8] AR: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."

folded.id: the example|of|the former peoples has preceded
folded.subject: the example

spans.text: [8] AR: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

folded.id: the favor|of|your lord when you have settled upon them and say
folded.subject: the favor
folded.object: your Lord when you have settled upon them and say

spans.text: [13] AR: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ EN: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say.

[32] AR: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ EN: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord?
But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
[4] AR: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ EN: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
[21] AR: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ EN: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?

[11] AR: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ EN: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
They have of that no knowledge.

[30] AR: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ EN: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
[34] AR: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ EN: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

[22] AR: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ EN: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

folded.id: when abraham|said|to his father and his people
folded.subject: when Abraham
folded.object: to his father and his people

spans.text: [26] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

folded.id: who disbelieve|in|the most merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
folded.subject: who disbelieve
folded.object: the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

spans.text: [33] AR: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ EN: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

folded.id: why|was|this qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

spans.text: [31] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ EN: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
